[TOOL Edit] {"replace_all": false, "file_path": "d:\\college\\development\\0\\HFusionHub\\java-backend\\src\\main\\java\\com\\hfusionhub\\service\\impl\\ConversationServiceImpl.java", "old_string": "    /**\n     * 批量转换 Conversation 为 ConversationInfoDTO（优化 N+1 查询）\n     */\n    private List<ConversationInfoDTO> batchConvertToInfoDTO(List<Conversation> conversations) {\n        if (conversations.isEmpty()) {\n            return List.of();\n        }\n\n        // 1. 收集所有 ID\n        List<Long> conversationIds = conversations.stream()\n                .map(Conversation::getId)\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        List<Long> kbIds = conversations.stream()\n                .map(Conversation::getKnowledgeBaseId)\n                .filter(id -> id != null)\n                .distinct()\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        List<Long> userIds = conversations.stream()\n                .map(Conversation::getUserId)\n                .filter(id -> id != null)\n                .distinct()\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        // 2. 批量查询知识库\n        Map<Long, String> kbNameMap = new HashMap<>();\n        if (!kbIds.isEmpty()) {\n            List<KnowledgeBase> kbs = knowledgeBaseMapper.selectBatchIds(kbIds);\n            kbs.forEach(kb -> kbNameMap.put(kb.getId(), kb.getName()));\n        }\n\n        // 3. 批量查询用户\n        Map<Long, String> userNameMap = new HashMap<>();\n        if (!userIds.isEmpty()) {\n            List<User> users = userMapper.selectBatchIds(userIds);\n            users.forEach(user -> {\n                String name = user.getNickname() != null ? user.getNickname() : user.getUsername();\n                userNameMap.put(user.getId(), name);\n            });\n        }\n\n        // 4. 批量查询消息数量\n        Map<Long, Long> messageCountMap = new HashMap<>();\n        LambdaQueryWrapper<Message> countWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();\n        countWrapper.in(Message::getConversationId, conversationIds);\n        countWrapper.select(Message::getConversationId, Message::getId);\n        List<Message> allMessages = messageMapper.selectList(countWrapper);\n        allMessages.forEach(m -> {\n            messageCountMap.merge(m.getConversationId(), 1L, Long::sum);\n        });\n\n        // 5. 批量查询最后一条消息\n        Map<Long, String> lastMessageMap = new HashMap<>();\n        if (!conversationIds.isEmpty()) {\n            // 使用子查询获取每个对话的最新消息\n            for (Long convId : conversationIds) {\n                LambdaQueryWrapper<Message> lastWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();\n                lastWrapper.eq(Message::getConversationId, convId)\n                        .orderByDesc(Message::getCreatedAt)\n                        .last(\"LIMIT 1\");\n                Message lastMessage = messageMapper.selectOne(lastWrapper);\n                if (lastMessage != null) {\n                    lastMessageMap.put(convId, lastMessage.getContent());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 6. 组装结果\n        return conversations.stream()\n                .map(conv -> ConversationInfoDTO.builder()\n                        .id(conv.getId())\n                        .knowledgeBaseId(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId())\n                        .knowledgeBaseName(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId() != null ? kbNameMap.getOrDefault(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId(), \"未知知识库\") : null)\n                        .userId(conv.getUserId())\n                        .userName(conv.getUserId() != null ? userNameMap.getOrDefault(conv.getUserId(), \"未知用户\") : null)\n                        .title(conv.getTitle())\n                        .messageCount(messageCountMap.getOrDefault(conv.getId(), 0L).intValue())\n                        .lastMessage(lastMessageMap.get(conv.getId()))\n                        .createdAt(conv.getCreatedAt())\n                        .updatedAt(conv.getUpdatedAt())\n                        .build())\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n    }", "new_string": "    /**\n     * 批量转换 Conversation → DTO。通过一次 SQL 聚合获取消息数量和最新消息。\n     */\n    private List<ConversationInfoDTO> batchConvertToInfoDTO(List<Conversation> conversations) {\n        if (conversations.isEmpty()) {\n            return List.of();\n        }\n\n        List<Long> conversationIds = conversations.stream().map(Conversation::getId).collect(Collectors.toList());\n        List<Long> kbIds = conversations.stream().map(Conversation::getKnowledgeBaseId).filter(id -> id != null).distinct().collect(Collectors.toList());\n        List<Long> userIds = conversations.stream().map(Conversation::getUserId).filter(id -> id != null).distinct().collect(Collectors.toList());\n\n        // 批量查询知识库名称\n        Map<Long, String> kbNameMap = new HashMap<>();\n        if (!kbIds.isEmpty()) {\n            knowledgeBaseMapper.selectBatchIds(kbIds).forEach(kb -> kbNameMap.put(kb.getId(), kb.getName()));\n        }\n\n        // 批量查询用户名\n        Map<Long, String> userNameMap = new HashMap<>();\n        if (!userIds.isEmpty()) {\n            userMapper.selectBatchIds(userIds).forEach(u -> userNameMap.put(u.getId(),\n                    u.getNickname() != null ? u.getNickname() : u.getUsername()));\n        }\n\n        // 一次 SQL 聚合：消息数量 + 最新消息\n        Map<Long, Long> messageCountMap = new HashMap<>();\n        Map<Long, String> lastMessageMap = new HashMap<>();\n        List<Map<String, Object>> aggregates = messageMapper.aggregateByConversationIds(conversationIds);\n        for (Map<String, Object> row : aggregates) {\n            Long convId = toLong(row.get(\"conversationId\"));\n            if (convId == null) continue;\n            messageCountMap.put(convId, toLong(row.get(\"msgCount\")));\n            lastMessageMap.put(convId, (String) row.get(\"lastMessage\"));\n        }\n\n        return conversations.stream()\n                .map(conv -> ConversationInfoDTO.builder()\n                        .id(conv.getId())\n                        .knowledgeBaseId(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId())\n                        .knowledgeBaseName(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId() != null ? kbNameMap.getOrDefault(conv.getKnowledgeBaseId(), \"未知知识库\") : null)\n                        .userId(conv.getUserId())\n                        .userName(userNameMap.getOrDefault(conv.getUserId(), \"未知用户\"))\n                        .title(conv.getTitle())\n                        .messageCount(messageCountMap.getOrDefault(conv.getId(), 0L).intValue())\n                        .lastMessage(lastMessageMap.get(conv.getId()))\n                        .createdAt(conv.getCreatedAt())\n                        .updatedAt(conv.getUpdatedAt())\n                        .build())\n                .collect(Collectors.toList());\n    }\n\n    private static Long toLong(Object value) {\n        if (value instanceof Number n) return n.longValue();\n        if (value instanceof String s) try { return Long.valueOf(s); } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}\n        return null;\n    }"}

}\n\n    /**\n     * 阶段 1: 短事务保存用户消息\n     */\n    @Transactional\n    public Message saveUserMessage(MessageSendDTO dto) {\n        Long currentUserId = JwtUtils.getCurrentUserId();\n userMessage.setRequestId(dto.getRequestId());\n        messageMapper.insert(userMessage);\n        return userMessage;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 阶段 3: 短事务保存助手消息并更新对话标题\n     */\n    @Transactional\n    public MessageInfoDTO saveAssistantMessage(Long conversationId,\n            String content, String model, int tokenCount,\n            Conversation conversation, String userContent) {\n        Message msg = new Message();\n        msg.setConversationId(conversationId);\n        msg.setRole(\"assistant\");\n        msg.setContent(content);\n        msg.setModel(model);\n        msg.setTokenCount(tokenCount);\n        messageMapper.insert(msg);\n        if (\"新对话\".equals(conversation.getTitle()) && StringUtils.hasText(userContent)) {\n            conversation.setTitle(userContent.length() > 50 ? userContent.substring(0, 50) + \"...\" : userContent);\n            conversationMapper.updateById(conversation);\n        }\n        return convertToMessageInfoDTO(msg);\n    }"}

4. Errors and fixes:

   - **Redis config ${REDIS_PASSWORD} not substituted**: Redis config files don't support shell-style `${VAR}` substitution. Fix: Moved `requirepass` from redis.conf to Docker Compose `command:` line where shell expansion works: `redis-server /usr/local/etc/redis/redis.conf --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD:?REDIS_PASSWORD must be set}`.

   - **REVOKE ALL + GRANT DML-only would break Flyway**: Initial V1 migration granted only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE (DML-only), which would prevent subsequent V2/V3/V4 Flyway migrations from executing (need CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, etc.). Fix: Included DDL permissions (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, INDEX, REFERENCES) alongside DML permissions. This is the practical minimum for an application that uses Flyway.

   - **Python test path incorrect**: `tests/test_retriever.py` doesn't exist in the project. Fix: Used the correct test path `tests/` with `--ignore=tests/test_embedding.py`.

   - **Docker Compose `config --quiet` fails without REDIS_PASSWORD**: The `docker compose config` command fails on `config --quiet` when `${REDIS_PASSWORD:?}` is not set. Fix: Provided dummy env var for validation: `REDIS_PASSWORD=test docker compose config --quiet`.

   - **Deprecated `version: '3.8'` attribute**: Docker Compose warns that the `version` attribute is obsolete. Fix: Removed the `version: '3.8'` line from docker-compose.yml.

5. Problem Solving:
   - **Milvus architecture decision**: Discovered that Python AI's `milvus_store.py:50` hardcodes `MilvusClient(uri=MILVUS_LITE_PATH)` (file-based local DB), while `milvus-docker/` maintained a complete standalone Milvus cluster (etcd + MinIO + Milvus + Attu) that was never connected. MinIO port 9000 conflicted with Python AI default port. Decision: Keep Milvus Lite (consistent with actual code), delete `milvus-docker/` directory entirely. Added docstring comment about how to switch to standalone if needed.

   - **Flyway migration strategy**: Migrated from Docker entrypoint-initdb.d SQL loading to Flyway. Used `baseline-on-migrate: true` so existing databases with tables already created can adopt Flyway without re-running migrations. SQL files moved to `db/migration/` following Flyway `V{version}__{description}.sql` naming convention. Original `sql/init.sql` kept as reference, along with `reset.sql` and `update_message_table.sql` as operational scripts.

   - **Health check password exposure**: MySQL healthcheck originally used `mysqladmin ping -h localhost -p${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}` which exposes the root password in `ps aux` output. Fixed by switching to Unix socket connection (omit `-h localhost`, no `-p` needed since local socket auth doesn't require password).

### 2. Sa-Token 配置

**文件：** `d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\java-backend\src\main\java\com\hfusionhub\config\SaTokenConfig.java`

```java
@Configuration
public class SaTokenConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
    @Override
    public void addInterceptors(InterceptorRegistry registry) {
        registry.addInterceptor(new SaInterceptor(handle -> {
            SaRouter.match("/**")
                    .notMatch(
                            "/user/login",
                            "/user/register",
                            "/health",
                            "/vectorize/*/callback",
                            "/doc.html",
                            "/swagger-ui.html",
                            "/swagger-ui/**",
                            "/v3/api-docs/**",
                            "/webjars/**"
                    )
                    .check(r -> StpUtil.checkLogin());
        })).addPathPatterns("/**");
    }
}
```

关键细节：
- 注册一个 `SaInterceptor`，用于除白名单路径外的所有路由。
- 白名单路径为 `/user/login`、`/user/register`、`/health`、`/vectorize/*/callback`、Swagger/文档路径。
- 注释说明上下文路径在拦截器匹配前已被剥离，因此模式路径相对于 `/api`（在 `application.yml` 中配置为 `server.servlet.context-path: /api`）。
- 此外，登录控制器中的Admin接口使用了 `@SaCheckRole("admin")`。

**application.yml 中的 Sa-Token 属性：**
```yaml
sa-token:
  token-name: satoken
  timeout: 86400           # 24小时
  active-timeout: 1800     # 30分钟无操作过期
  is-concurrent: true      # 允许多端登录
  token-style: uuid
  is-log: false
```

**Sa-Token Token 存储：** 通过 `sa-token-redis-jackson` 使用 Redis（在 `pom.xml` 中声明）。这意味着 Sa-Token 会话状态持久化在 Redis 中。

**`JwtUtils`（`d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\java-backend\src\main\java\com\hfusionhub\common\utils\JwtUtils.java`）：**
- 实现 `StpInterface` 以提供权限/角色查询。
- `getPermissionList()` 返回空列表。
- `getRoleList()` 从 `UserMapper` 数据库中加载用户角色，发生异常时默认返回 `["user"]`。
- 还提供静态包装方法：`login()`、`logout()`、`getCurrentUserId()`、`hasRole()`、`hasPermission()` 等。

### 3. Auth 过滤器/拦截器与限流

**自定义过滤器：** 无。没有实现 `jakarta.servlet.Filter` 的类。

**自定义拦截器：** 无。没有实现 `HandlerInterceptor` 的类，也没有通过 Sa-Token 之外的方式注册的自定义拦截器。

**认证：**
- 完全由 `SaTokenConfig` 中的 Sa-Token `SaInterceptor` 处理。
- 基于注解的检查：`UserController.getUserById()` 上的 `@SaCheckRole("admin")`。
- 异常处理：`GlobalExceptionHandler` 处理 `NotLoginException`（返回 401）、`NotPermissionException`（返回 403）和 `NotRoleException`（返回 403）。

**`UserServiceImpl.login()` 流程：**
1. 按用户名查询用户（使用 `LambdaQueryWrapper`）。
2. 若用户不存在则抛出 `BusinessException(1001, "用户名或密码错误")`。
3. 若 `user.getStatus() == 1`（禁用）则抛出 `BusinessException(1002, "用户已被禁用")`。
4. 使用 `BCrypt.checkpw()` 验证密码；若失败则抛出 `BusinessException(1001, "用户名或密码错误")`。
5. 更新 `last_login_time`。
6. 调用 `jwtUtils.login(user.getId())` → `StpUtil.login(userId)`。
7. 返回 `jwtUtils.getTokenValue()`。

27	@Slf4j

32	    private final UserMapper userMapper;
33	    private final JwtUtils jwtUtils;

35	    /**
36	     * 用户登录
37	     *
38	     * @param loginDTO 登录请求
39	     * @return Token
40	     */
41	    @Override
42	    public String login(UserLoginDTO loginDTO) {
43	        // 根据用户名查询用户
44	        LambdaQueryWrapper<User> wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();
45	        wrapper.eq(User::getUsername, loginDTO.getUsername());
46	        User user = userMapper.selectOne(wrapper);
47	
48	        // 校验用户是否存在
49	        if (user == null) {
50	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.LOGIN_ERROR, "用户名或密码错误");
51	        }
52	
53	        // 校验用户状态
54	        if (user.getStatus() == 1) {
55	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.USER_DISABLED, "用户已被禁用");
56	        }
57	
58	        // 校验密码
59	        if (!BCrypt.checkpw(loginDTO.getPassword(), user.getPassword())) {
60	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.LOGIN_ERROR, "用户名或密码错误");
61	        }
62	
63	        // 更新最后登录时间
64	        user.setLastLoginTime(LocalDateTime.now());
65	        userMapper.updateById(user);
66	
67	        // 登录
68	        jwtUtils.login(user.getId());
69	
70	        log.info("用户登录成功，userId: {}, username: {}", user.getId(), user.getUsername());
71	        return jwtUtils.getTokenValue();
72	    }
73	
74	    /**
75	     * 用户注册
76	     *
77	     * @param registerDTO 注册请求
78	     * @return 用户信息
79	     */
80	    @Override
81	    public UserInfoDTO register(UserRegisterDTO registerDTO) {
82	        // 检查用户名是否已存在
83	        LambdaQueryWrapper<User> wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();
84	        wrapper.eq(User::getUsername, registerDTO.getUsername());
85	        Long count = userMapper.selectCount(wrapper);
86	        if (count > 0) {
87	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.USER_EXISTS, "用户名已存在");
88	        }
89	
90	        // 检查邮箱是否已存在（如果填写了邮箱）
91	        if (registerDTO.getEmail() != null && !registerDTO.getEmail().isEmpty()) {
92	            LambdaQueryWrapper<User> emailWrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();
93	            emailWrapper.eq(User::getEmail, registerDTO.getEmail());
94	            Long emailCount = userMapper.selectCount(emailWrapper);
95	            if (emailCount > 0) {
96	                throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.USER_EXISTS, "邮箱已被注册");
97	            }
98	        }
99	
100	        // 创建用户
101	        User user = new User();
102	        user.setUsername(registerDTO.getUsername());
103	        user.setPassword(BCrypt.hashpw(registerDTO.getPassword()));
104	        user.setNickname(registerDTO.getNickname());
105	        user.setEmail(registerDTO.getEmail());
106	        user.setPhone(registerDTO.getPhone());
107	        user.setRole("user");
108	        user.setStatus(0);
109	
110	        userMapper.insert(user);
111	
112	        log.info("用户注册成功，userId: {}, username: {}", user.getId(), user.getUsername());
113	        return convertToUserInfoDTO(user);
114	    }
115

117	     * 用户登出

121	        jwtUtils.logout();

123	    }
124	
125	    /**
126	     * 获取当前用户信息
127	     *
128	     * @return 用户信息
129	     */
130	    @Override
131	    public UserInfoDTO getCurrentUser() {
132	        Long userId = jwtUtils.getCurrentUserId();
133	        User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
134	        if (user == null) {
135	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.NOT_FOUND, "用户不存在");
136	        }
137	        return convertToUserInfoDTO(user);
138	    }
139	
140	    /**
141	     * 更新用户信息
142	     *
143	     * @param updateDTO 更新请求
144	     * @return 用户信息
145	     */
146	    @Override
147	    public UserInfoDTO updateUser(UserUpdateDTO updateDTO) {
148	        Long userId = jwtUtils.getCurrentUserId();
149	        User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
150	        if (user == null) {
151	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.NOT_FOUND, "用户不存在");
152	        }
153	
154	        // 更新字段（只更新非空字段）
155	        if (updateDTO.getNickname() != null) {
156	            user.setNickname(updateDTO.getNickname());
157	        }
158	        if (updateDTO.getEmail() != null) {
159	            // 检查邮箱是否已被其他用户使用
160	            LambdaQueryWrapper<User> wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();
161	            wrapper.eq(User::getEmail, updateDTO.getEmail())
162	                    .ne(User::getId, userId);
163	            Long count = userMapper.selectCount(wrapper);
164	            if (count > 0) {
165	                throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.USER_EXISTS, "邮箱已被其他用户使用");
166	            }
167	            user.setEmail(updateDTO.getEmail());
168	        }
169	        if (updateDTO.getPhone() != null) {
170	            user.setPhone(updateDTO.getPhone());
171	        }
172	        if (updateDTO.getAvatar() != null) {
173	            user.setAvatar(updateDTO.getAvatar());
174	        }
175	
176	        userMapper.updateById(user);
177	
178	        log.info("用户信息更新成功，userId: {}", userId);
179	        return convertToUserInfoDTO(user);
180	    }
181	
182	    /**
183	     * 根据用户ID获取用户信息（管理员或本人）
184	     *
185	     * @param userId 用户ID
186	     * @return 用户信息
187	     */
188	    @Override
189	    public UserInfoDTO getUserById(Long userId) {
190	        // 权限校验：管理员可查看任意用户，普通用户只能查看自己
191	        Long currentUserId = JwtUtils.getCurrentUserId();
192	        if (!JwtUtils.hasRole(CommonConstants.ROLE_ADMIN) && !currentUserId.equals(userId)) {
193	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.FORBIDDEN, "无权查看其他用户信息");
194	        }
195	        User user = userMapper.selectById(userId);
196	        if (user == null) {
197	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.NOT_FOUND, "用户不存在");
198	        }
199	        return convertToUserInfoDTO(user);
200	    }
201	
202	    /**
203	     * 根据用户名获取用户信息
204	     *
205	     * @param username 用户名
206	     * @return 用户信息
207	     */
208	    @Override
209	    public UserInfoDTO getUserByUsername(String username) {
210	        LambdaQueryWrapper<User> wrapper = new LambdaQueryWrapper<>();
211	        wrapper.eq(User::getUsername, username);
212	        User user = userMapper.selectOne(wrapper);
213	        if (user == null) {
214	            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.NOT_FOUND, "用户不存在");
215	        }
216	        return convertToUserInfoDTO(user);
217	    }
218	
219	    /**
220	     * User 实体转换为 UserInfoDTO
221	     *
222	     * @param user 用户实体
223	     * @return 用户信息DTO
224	     */
225	    private UserInfoDTO convertToUserInfoDTO(User user) {
226	        return UserInfoDTO.builder()
227	                .id(user.getId())
228	                .username(user.getUsername())
229	                .nickname(user.getNickname())
230	                .email(user.getEmail())
231	                .phone(user.getPhone())
232	                .avatar(user.getAvatar())
233	                .role(user.getRole())
234	                .status(user.getStatus())
235	                .lastLoginTime(user.getLastLoginTime())
236	                .createdAt(user.getCreatedAt())
237	                .build();
238	    }
239	}

## Phase 6 -- Implementation Plan: Testing, Environment, and CI

### Design Decisions

**Decision 1 -- H2 vs Testcontainers for Java Integration Tests**

Recommendation: **H2 in MySQL compatibility mode** for the main test suite, with Testcontainers available via a Maven profile for optional full integration tests.

Justification: The CI environment currently has no service containers for MySQL and Redis. Adding H2 removes the Docker dependency, makes the default `mvn test` fast (sub-second startup), and MySQL compatibility mode handles the DDL in the Flyway migrations (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, etc.). The compatibility differences (e.g., `TINYINT` vs `BOOLEAN`, `JSON` vs `VARCHAR`) are manageable at the DAO test level. A Maven profile `itest` activates Testcontainers for developers who want a full MySQL/Redis stack locally.

**Decision 2 -- pip-tools for Python Dependency Locking**

Recommendation: **pip-tools** (`pip-compile` + `pip-sync`).

Justification: The project already uses pip and a `requirements.txt`. pip-tools is the minimal-change approach -- add `requirements.in`, run `pip-compile` to produce a locked `requirements.txt` with sub-dependency hashes. uv is faster but requires a new build tool adoption; Poetry is more opinionated (project metadata, virtualenv management). pip-tools buys the lock-file guarantee with nearly zero process change.

**Decision 3 -- Admin Creation Mechanism**

Recommendation: **Environment-variable-based `ApplicationRunner`** combined with a no-op V5 migration.

Justification: The V1 migration already applied INSERT IGNORE on existing deployments and cannot be retroactively modified (Flyway checksum). For fresh installs, the V1 is unchanged but rendered harmless because the `AdminInitializer` component will detect and override the default password if `ADMIN_PASSWORD` is set. The V5 migration is an empty marker that documents the version history. This is fully backward compatible.

**Decision 4 -- Rate Limiting Approach**

Recommendation: **Spring `HandlerInterceptor`** with Redis counters, registered specifically for `/user/login` and `/user/register` paths.

Justification: An interceptor is more centralized than per-method annotations (no need to annotate every controller method). It directly reuses `RedisUtils` and the `REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX` constant already in `CommonConstants`. The interceptor stores per-IP counters in Redis with TTL, and an audit log entry is emitted on lockout.

**Decision 5 -- Integration Test Scope**

Recommendation: **File-based H2** for unit-level integration tests (Controller, Service layers with MockMvc). A separate `@SpringBootTest` class using H2 with Flyway for migration tests.

Justification: This avoids any Docker dependency in CI while still testing the Spring context wiring, controller routing, validation, and service logic. Actual MySQL dialect edge cases are handled by the optional Testcontainers profile.

@WebMvcTest(HealthController.class)

class HealthControllerTest {
    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @Test
    void healthReturnsUpStatus() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/health"))
               .andExpect(status().isOk())
               .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.status").value("UP"))
               .andExpect(jsonPath("$.data.timestamp").isNotEmpty());
    }
}
```
- Note: the context-path `/api` is handled by `spring.servlet.context-path` in the test properties. For `@WebMvcTest`, the path in MockMvc should include the prefix, OR set `spring.servlet.context-path:` to empty in the test profile and adjust paths.

Actually, `@WebMvcTest` does NOT load full application context -- it only loads the specified controller and its dependencies. So `spring.servlet.context-path` from `application-test.yml` won't be applied unless we use `spring.test.context.context-path.enabled=true`. Better approach: use `@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = WebEnvironment.MOCK)` with `@AutoConfigureMockMvc` and set `spring.servlet.context-path` in test YAML. OR strip the context-path from test config and use absolute paths.

Preferred approach: keep the context-path in test YAML and use `.contextPath("/api")` on the MockMvc builder, OR use `@SpringBootTest` which reads all properties including `server.servlet.context-path`.

**Recommended pattern**: Use `@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = WebEnvironment.MOCK)` for integration tests that need the full context, and `@WebMvcTest` for focused controller tests with mocked services. For the `@WebMvcTest` case, the `server.servlet.context-path` is NOT applied (it's a web-server property), so paths in MockMvc must start with the full path including `/api`.

    @Override
    public void run(ApplicationArguments args) {
        if (adminPassword == null || adminPassword.isBlank()) {
            log.warn("ADMIN_PASSWORD not set. Default admin user disabled.");
            return;
        }

        User admin = userMapper.selectOne(
            new LambdaQueryWrapper<User>().eq(User::getUsername, adminUsername)
        );
        if (admin == null) {
            // Create admin user
            admin = new User();
            admin.setUsername(adminUsername);
            admin.setPassword(BCrypt.hashpw(adminPassword));
            admin.setNickname("Administrator");
            admin.setRole(CommonConstants.ROLE_ADMIN);
            admin.setStatus(0);
            userMapper.insert(admin);
            log.info("Admin user '{}' created from environment configuration.", adminUsername);
        } else if (!BCrypt.checkpw(adminPassword, admin.getPassword())) {
            // Update password if it changed
            admin.setPassword(BCrypt.hashpw(adminPassword));
            userMapper.updateById(admin);
            log.info("Admin user '{}' password updated from environment configuration.", adminUsername);
        } else {
            log.info("Admin user '{}' already configured correctly.", adminUsername);
        }
    }
}
```

#### Step 8: Java -- Login Rate Limiting

**File to create: `java-backend/src/main/java/com/hfusionhub/common/limiter/LoginRateLimiter.java`**
```java
@Component
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class LoginRateLimiter {
    private final RedisUtils redisUtils;

    private static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
    private static final long WINDOW_SECONDS = 900;  // 15 min window
    private static final long LOCKOUT_SECONDS = 900; // 15 min lockout after max

    public boolean isBlocked(String ip) {
        String lockKey = CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + "lockout:" + ip;
        return redisUtils.hasKey(lockKey);
    }

    public void recordAttempt(String ip, boolean success) {
        if (success) {
            // Clear failed attempts on success
            String attemptKey = CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + "attempt:" + ip;
            redisUtils.delete(attemptKey);
            return;
        }

        String attemptKey = CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + "attempt:" + ip;
        long attempts = redisUtils.increment(attemptKey, 1);
        if (attempts == 1) {
            redisUtils.expire(attemptKey, WINDOW_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }

        if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            String lockKey = CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + "lockout:" + ip;
            redisUtils.set(lockKey, String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis()), LOCKOUT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            log.warn("Login rate limit exceeded for IP: {}. Locked out for {} seconds.", ip, LOCKOUT_SECONDS);
        }
    }
}
```

**File to create: `java-backend/src/main/java/com/hfusionhub/config/WebMvcConfig.java`** (or modify `SaTokenConfig.java`)
- Add a `LoginRateLimitInterceptor` that checks rate limit before login/register requests:
```java
@Component
public class LoginRateLimitInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
    private final LoginRateLimiter rateLimiter;

    @Override
    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Object handler) {
        String ip = request.getRemoteAddr();
        if (rateLimiter.isBlocked(ip)) {
            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, "请求过于频繁，请稍后重试");
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

            .order(1);

    // Sa-Token interceptor (order 2)

Actually, a cleaner approach: Use a `@Around` aspect or AOP around the login/register controller methods. But since we want to track per-IP, the interceptor is the right place. The interceptor only blocks if the IP is locked out. The actual counting of failed vs successful attempts happens inside `UserServiceImpl`.

Better design:
- **Interceptor** preHandle: checks if IP is in lockout set. If yes, reject with 429.
- **`UserServiceImpl.login()`**: on BusinessException (login error), call `rateLimiter.recordFailedAttempt(ip)`. on success, call `rateLimiter.recordSuccess(ip)`.
- Use Spring `RequestContextHolder` to extract client IP in the service layer.

### Potential Challenges and Mitigations

1. **Sa-Token context in tests**: Sa-Token's `StpUtil` is a static facade that delegates to `SaTokenContext` via `SaManager`. Without Redis, `StpUtil.login()` fails because there's no context implementation. Mitigation: use `@AutoConfigureMockMvc(addFilters = false)` to bypass the SaInterceptor entirely, and for `@SpringBootTest` tests, create a `TestSaTokenConfig` with an in-memory `SaTokenContext`.

2. **H2 MySQL compatibility**: `TINYINT` is not an H2 type (use `BOOLEAN` or `SMALLINT`). `JSON` column type is not supported (use `VARCHAR` with `@TableField(typeHandler = ...)`). The Flyway migrations use MySQL syntax -- H2 in MySQL mode handles `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, `ENGINE=InnoDB`, `AUTO_INCREMENT`, `DEFAULT CHARSET` (ignores them). `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` is not supported in H2 even in MySQL mode. Mitigation: the Flyway migration test runs against real MySQL via service containers, not H2. The H2 is only for unit/service tests.

3. **Flyway migration V1 checksum**: If we modify `V1__initial_schema.sql`, existing deployments will fail checksum validation. The plan keeps V1 entirely unchanged and adds V5 as a marker.

4. **Rate limit tests with real Redis**: Since Redis is mocked in unit tests, the rate limit tests need to verify the Redis interaction logic. Mitigation: test the `LoginRateLimiter` with a mocked `RedisUtils` that uses `ConcurrentHashMap`, verifying key creation, TTL, and threshold logic.

## Approved Plan:
# 第六阶段：测试、环境和持续集成（P1/P2）

## Context

Phase 5 完成了 Docker 和数据库加固。当前基础设施仍存在以下问题：

1. **Java 测试贫困** — 仅 2 个纯 JUnit 测试（无 Spring 上下文），无 `@WebMvcTest`/`MockMvc`，无集成测试
2. **CI 中的 Java 测试无法运行** — `mvn test` 需要 MySQL + Redis 但 CI 无服务容器
3. **Python SERVER_DEBUG 默认为 true** — 生产部署默认开启热重载
4. **Python 无依赖锁文件** — `requirements.txt` 手动编写，无可重现构建保障
5. **默认 admin/admin123 硬编码** — V1 Flyway 迁移包含 `INSERT IGNORE` 默认管理员
6. **登录/注册无限流** — 可被暴力破解，无失败锁定，无审计日志
7. **npm audit 未配置** — CI 不检查前端漏洞
8. **CI 不验证 Docker Compose** — 无配置校验步骤

## 设计决策

### 决策 1：H2 数据库用于 Java 测试（非 Testcontainers）

**选择：H2 MySQL 兼容模式** 用于单元测试（`application-test.yml`），可选 Testcontainers Maven profile。

理由：
- H2 零依赖启动（无 Docker 要求），CI 可直接运行 `mvn test`
- MySQL 兼容模式处理大多数 DDL（`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`、`ENGINE=InnoDB` 被忽略）
- Flyway 迁移验证在 CI 中针对真实 MySQL 服务容器运行
- Testcontainers 仅在 `-P itest` profile 中可用，供开发者本地使用

### 决策 2：pip-tools 用于 Python 依赖锁定

**选择：pip-tools**（`pip-compile` + `pip-sync`）。

理由：项目已使用 pip + `requirements.txt`，pip-tools 是最小改动方案——新增 `requirements.in`，运行 `pip-compile` 生成含哈希的锁定文件。uv 更快但需更换工具链；Poetry 更重量级。`requirements.txt` 保持为唯一定义源。

### 决策 3：通过环境变量创建管理员，V1 保持不变

**选择：`ApplicationRunner` + V5 清理迁移**。

理由：
- V1 的 `INSERT IGNORE` 不能回退修改（Flyway 校验和会失败）
- V5 迁移通过 bcrypt 哈希特征安全删除默认 admin
- `AdminInitializer` 仅在 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` 环境变量设置时创建管理员
- 向后兼容：现有部署的 V1-V4 校验和不受影响

### 决策 4：Spring HandlerInterceptor 限流方案

**选择：`HandlerInterceptor` + 基于 Redis 的 IP 计数器**。

理由：
- 复用 `CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX` 常量和 `RedisUtils`
- 比注解驱动的 AOP 更集中（无需为每个端点注解）
- 在认证拦截器之前检查锁定 IP，尽早拒绝
- 在 `UserServiceImpl` 中记录失败/成功尝试

26	/**
27	 * RAG 调试与评测 API 网关。
28	 *
29	 * 浏览器只访问 Java 后端；该控制器将内部 Python AI 服务的调试接口统一
30	 * 暴露在 /api/rag 下，避免前端依赖 Python 服务的端口和部署地址。
31	 */
32	@Slf4j
33	@RestController
34	@RequestMapping("/rag")
35	@RequiredArgsConstructor
36	public class RagObservabilityController {
37	
38	    private final RestTemplate restTemplate;
39	    private final KnowledgeBaseMapper knowledgeBaseMapper;
40	
41	    @Value("${ai-service.base-url:http://localhost:9000}")
42	    private String aiServiceBaseUrl;
43	
44	    @Value("${python-ai.internal-token:}")
45	    private String internalApiToken;
46	
47	    @GetMapping("/traces")
48	    public R<Map> listTraces(
49	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "50") int limit,
50	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int offset,
51	            @RequestParam Long knowledgeBaseId,
52	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "false") boolean errorOnly,
53	            @RequestParam(required = false) String query,
54	            @RequestParam(required = false) String source
55	    ) {
56	        requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
57	        if (limit < 1 || limit > 200) {
58	            throw new BusinessException("limit 必须在 1 到 200 之间");
59	        }
60	        if (offset < 0 || offset > 1000) {
61	            throw new BusinessException("offset 必须在 0 到 1000 之间");
62	        }
63	        return R.ok(get(getTraceResourceBuilder("/api/rag/traces")
64	                .queryParam("limit", limit)
65	                .queryParam("offset", offset)
66	                .queryParam("knowledge_base_id", knowledgeBaseId)
67	                .queryParam("error_only", errorOnly)
68	                .queryParamIfPresent("query", java.util.Optional.ofNullable(query))
69	                .queryParamIfPresent("source", java.util.Optional.ofNullable(source))
70	                .toUriString()));
71	    }
72	
73	    @GetMapping("/traces/stats")
74	    public R<Map> traceStats(
75	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "7") int days,
76	            @RequestParam Long knowledgeBaseId) {
77	        requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
78	        if (days < 1 || days > 30) {
79	            throw new BusinessException("days 必须在 1 到 30 之间");
80	        }
81	        return R.ok(get(getTraceResourceBuilder("/api/rag/traces/stats")
82	                .queryParam("days", days)
83	                .queryParam("knowledge_base_id", knowledgeBaseId)
84	                .toUriString()));
85	    }
86	
87	    @GetMapping("/traces/export")
88	    public R<Map> exportTraces(
89	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "json") String format,
90	            @RequestParam Long knowledgeBaseId,
91	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "false") boolean errorOnly,
92	            @RequestParam(required = false) String query,
93	            @RequestParam(required = false) String source
94	    ) {
95	        requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
96	        if (!"json".equalsIgnoreCase(format) && !"csv".equalsIgnoreCase(format)) {
97	            throw new BusinessException("format 只能是 json 或 csv");
98	        }
99	        return R.ok(get(getTraceResourceBuilder("/api/rag/traces/export")
100	                .queryParam("format", format)
101	                .queryParam("knowledge_base_id", knowledgeBaseId)
102	                .queryParam("error_only", errorOnly)
103	                .queryParamIfPresent("query", java.util.Optional.ofNullable(query))
104	                .queryParamIfPresent("source", java.util.Optional.ofNullable(source))
105	                .toUriString()));
106	    }
107	
108	    @GetMapping("/traces/{traceId}")
109	    public R<Map> getTrace(@PathVariable String traceId, @RequestParam Long knowledgeBaseId) {
110	        requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
111	        Map trace = get(getTraceResourceBuilder("/api/rag/traces/" + traceId)
112	                .queryParam("knowledge_base_id", knowledgeBaseId)
113	                .toUriString());
114	        Object traceKbId = trace.get("knowledge_base_id");
115	        if (!(traceKbId instanceof Number) || ((Number) traceKbId).longValue() != knowledgeBaseId) {
116	            throw new BusinessException("检索记录不存在或无权访问");
117	        }
118	        return R.ok(trace);
119	    }
120	
121	    @PostMapping("/evaluate")
122	    public R<Map> evaluate(@RequestBody Map<String, Object> request) {
123	        try {
124	            Long knowledgeBaseId = requiredKnowledgeBaseId(request.get("knowledge_base_id"));
125	            requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
126	            HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
127	            headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
128	            addInternalToken(headers);
129	            Map response = restTemplate.postForObject(
130	                    aiServiceBaseUrl + "/api/rag/evaluate",
131	                    new HttpEntity<>(request, headers),
132	                    Map.class
133	            );
134	            return R.ok(response);
135	        } catch (Exception exception) {
136	            if (exception instanceof BusinessException businessException) {
137	                throw businessException;
138	            }
139	            log.error("RAG evaluation request failed", exception);
140	            throw new BusinessException("RAG 评测服务不可用");
141	        }
142	    }
143	
144	    @GetMapping("/evaluation-runs")
145	    public R<Map> listEvaluationRuns(
146	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "50") int limit,
147	            @RequestParam Long knowledgeBaseId
148	    ) {
149	        requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(knowledgeBaseId);
150	        if (limit < 1 || limit > 200) {
151	            throw new BusinessException("limit 必须在 1 到 200 之间");
152	        }
153	        return R.ok(get(getTraceResourceBuilder("/api/rag/evaluation-runs")
154	                .queryParam("limit", limit)
155	                .queryParam("knowledge_base_id", knowledgeBaseId)
156	                .toUriString()));
157	    }
158	
159	    private Map get(String url) {
160	        try {
161	            Map response = restTemplate.exchange(
162	                    url, org.springframework.http.HttpMethod.GET,
163	                    new HttpEntity<>(internalHeaders()), Map.class).getBody();
164	            if (response == null) {
165	                throw new BusinessException("RAG 服务返回为空");
166	            }
167	            return response;
168	        } catch (BusinessException exception) {
169	            throw exception;
170	        } catch (Exception exception) {
171	            log.error("RAG observability request failed: {}", url, exception);
172	            throw new BusinessException("RAG 调试服务不可用");
173	        }
174	    }
175	
176	    private UriComponentsBuilder getTraceResourceBuilder(String path) {
177	        return UriComponentsBuilder.fromHttpUrl(aiServiceBaseUrl).path(path);
178	    }
179	
180	    private void requireOwnedKnowledgeBase(Long knowledgeBaseId) {
181	        if (knowledgeBaseId == null || knowledgeBaseId < 1) {
182	            throw new BusinessException("knowledgeBaseId 必须提供");
183	        }
184	        KnowledgeBase knowledgeBase = knowledgeBaseMapper.selectById(knowledgeBaseId);
185	        if (knowledgeBase == null || !knowledgeBase.getUserId().equals(JwtUtils.getCurrentUserId())) {
186	            throw new BusinessException("无权访问该知识库");
187	        }
188	    }
189	
190	    private Long requiredKnowledgeBaseId(Object value) {
191	        if (value instanceof Number number) {
192	            return number.longValue();
193	        }
194	        if (value instanceof String string) {
195	            try {
196	                return Long.valueOf(string);
197	            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
198	                // Fall through to the same client-facing validation error.
199	            }
200	        }
201	        throw new BusinessException("knowledge_base_id 必须提供");
202	    }
203	
204	    private HttpHeaders internalHeaders() {
205	        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
206	        addInternalToken(headers);
207	        return headers;
208	    }
209	
210	    private void addInternalToken(HttpHeaders headers) {
211	        if (internalApiToken == null || internalApiToken.isBlank()) {
212	            throw new BusinessException("PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN 未配置");
213	        }
214	        headers.set("X-Internal-Token", internalApiToken);
215	    }
216	}

[TOOL Write] {"file_path": "d:\\college\\development\\0\\HFusionHub\\java-backend\\src\\main\\java\\com\\hfusionhub\\config\\AdminInitializer.java", "content": "package com.hfusionhub.config;\n\nimport cn.hutool.crypto.digest.BCrypt;\nimport com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.conditions.query.LambdaQueryWrapper;\nimport com.hfusionhub.common.constant.CommonConstants;\nimport com.hfusionhub.entity.User;\nimport com.hfusionhub.mapper.UserMapper;\nimport lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;\nimport lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;\nimport org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;\nimport org.springframework.boot.ApplicationArguments;\nimport org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\n/**\n * Creates or updates the admin user on first startup using the\n * {@code ADMIN_PASSWORD} environment variable.\n *\n * <p>If {@code ADMIN_PASSWORD} is not set, admin creation is skipped and a\n * warning is logged.  The V5 Flyway migration removes the default\n * {@code admin / admin123} account, so a fresh deployment will have no admin\n * user until this runner is supplied with a password.\n */\n@Slf4j\n@Component\n@RequiredArgsConstructor\npublic class AdminInitializer implements ApplicationRunner {\n\n    private final UserMapper userMapper;\n\n    @Value(\"${app.admin.username:admin}\")\n    private String adminUsername;\n\n    @Value(\"${app.admin.password:}\")\n    private String adminPassword;\n\n    @Override\n    public void run(ApplicationArguments args) {\n        if (adminPassword == null || adminPassword.isBlank()) {\n            log.warn(\"ADMIN_PASSWORD is not set. Admin user will NOT be created. \"\n                    + \"Set the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable to bootstrap the admin account.\");\n            return;\n        }\n\n        User admin = userMapper.selectOne(\n                new LambdaQueryWrapper<User>().eq(User::getUsername, adminUsername));\n\n        if (admin == null) {\n            // First run — create admin user\n            admin = new User();\n            admin.setUsername(adminUsername);\n            admin.setPassword(BCrypt.hashpw(adminPassword));\n            admin.setNickname(\"Administrator\");\n            admin.setRole(CommonConstants.ROLE_ADMIN);\n            admin.setStatus(0);\n            userMapper.insert(admin);\n            log.info(\"Admin user '{}' created from ADMIN_PASSWORD.\", adminUsername);\n        } else if (!BCrypt.checkpw(adminPassword, admin.getPassword())) {\n            // Password changed via environment — update it\n            admin.setPassword(BCrypt.hashpw(adminPassword));\n            userMapper.updateById(admin);\n            log.info(\"Admin user '{}' password updated from ADMIN_PASSWORD.\", adminUsername);\n        } else {\n            log.info(\"Admin user '{}' already configured correctly.\", adminUsername);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"}

[TOOL Write] {"file_path": "d:\\college\\development\\0\\HFusionHub\\java-backend\\src\\main\\java\\com\\hfusionhub\\common\\limiter\\LoginRateLimiter.java", "content": "package com.hfusionhub.common.limiter;\n\nimport com.hfusionhub.common.constant.CommonConstants;\nimport com.hfusionhub.common.constant.StatusCode;\nimport com.hfusionhub.common.exception.BusinessException;\nimport com.hfusionhub.common.utils.RedisUtils;\nimport lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;\nimport lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;\nimport org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\n\nimport java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;\n\n/**\n * Redis-based login rate limiter.\n *\n * <p>Tracks failed login attempts per IP address.  After {@value #MAX_ATTEMPTS}\n * failures within {@value #WINDOW_SECONDS} seconds the IP is locked out for\n * {@value #LOCKOUT_SECONDS} seconds.  A successful login clears the counter.\n */\n@Slf4j\n@Component\n@RequiredArgsConstructor\npublic class LoginRateLimiter {\n\n    private final RedisUtils redisUtils;\n\n    /** Maximum failed attempts before lockout. */\n    static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;\n\n    /** Sliding window for counting failures (seconds). */\n    static final long WINDOW_SECONDS = 900; // 15 minutes\n\n    /** Lockout duration after exceeding max attempts (seconds). */\n    static final long LOCKOUT_SECONDS = 900; // 15 minutes\n\n    private String attemptKey(String ip) {\n        return CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + \"attempt:\" + ip;\n    }\n\n    private String lockoutKey(String ip) {\n        return CommonConstants.REDIS_LIMIT_PREFIX + \"lockout:\" + ip;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Returns {@code true} if the IP is currently locked out.\n     */\n    public boolean isBlocked(String ip) {\n        return redisUtils.hasKey(lockoutKey(ip));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Throws {@link BusinessException} with HTTP 429 if the IP is blocked.\n     */\n    public void checkBlocked(String ip) {\n        if (isBlocked(ip)) {\n            log.warn(\"LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_BLOCKED ip={}\", ip);\n            throw new BusinessException(StatusCode.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, \"请求过于频繁，请15分钟后重试\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Record a failed login attempt for the given IP.\n     * Locks out the IP if the threshold is exceeded.\n     */\n    public void recordFailedAttempt(String ip) {\n        String key = attemptKey(ip);\n        long attempts = redisUtils.increment(key, 1);\n        if (attempts == 1) {\n            redisUtils.expire(key, WINDOW_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);\n        }\n\n        if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {\n            String lockKey = lockoutKey(ip);\n            redisUtils.set(lockKey, String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis()),\n                    LOCKOUT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);\n            log.warn(\"LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_LOCKED_OUT ip={} attempts={}\", ip, attempts);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Clear failed attempt counter after a successful login.\n     */\n    public void recordSuccess(String ip) {\n        redisUtils.delete(attemptKey(ip));\n    }\n}\n"}

Registered for {@code /user/login} and\n * {@code /user/register} only.\n */\n@Slf4j\n@Component\n@RequiredArgsConstructor\npublic class LoginRateLimitInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {\n\n    private final LoginRateLimiter rateLimiter;\n\n    @Override\n    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response,\n                             Object handler) {\n        String ip = IpUtils.getClientIp(request);\n        rateLimiter.checkBlocked(ip);\n        return true;\n    }\n}\n"}

3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Repository Structure
6	
7	HFusionHub is a **three-tier monorepo** enterprise AI Agent platform with a Java + Python hybrid architecture.
8	
9	```
10	HFusionHub/
11	├── java-backend/           # Spring Boot 3.2.5 backend (port 8080)
12	├── python-ai/              # FastAPI AI service (port 9000)
13	├── hfusionhub-frontend/    # Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript SPA (port 3000)
14	├── docker/                 # Docker Compose: MySQL 8.0 + Redis 7
15	├── milvus-docker/          # Milvus + etcd + MinIO + Attu
16	├── scripts/                # PowerShell verification scripts
17	└── .github/workflows/      # CI pipeline
18	```
19	
20	## Key Commands
21	
22	### Java Backend
23	```bash
24	cd java-backend
25	mvn spring-boot:run          # Run dev server
26	mvn test                      # Run all tests
27	mvn test -Dtest=HealthControllerTest  # Run single test
28	mvn package                   # Build JAR
29	```
30	
31	### Python AI Service
32	```bash
33	cd python-ai
34	pip install -r requirements.txt              # Install deps
35	pip install -r requirements-dev.txt          # Install test deps
36	python -m app.main                           # Run dev server
37	pytest -q tests                              # Run all tests
38	pytest -q tests/test_retriever.py            # Run single test file
39	pytest -q -k "test_intent_classify"          # Run specific test
40	```
41	
42	### Frontend
43	```bash
44	cd hfusionhub-frontend
45	npm ci                                        # Install deps (clean)
46	npm run dev                                   # Run dev server
47	npm run build                                 # Type-check + build
48	npm run preview                               # Preview production build
49	```
50	
51	### Infrastructure
52	```bash
53	cd docker && docker compose up -d             # Start MySQL + Redis
54	cd milvus-docker && docker compose up -d      # Start Milvus vector DB
55	```
56	
57	### CI (runs on push/PR to main — 3 parallel jobs)
58	```bash
59	# Python tests, Java tests, and Frontend build run in parallel
60	# No linting/formatting is configured for any subproject
61	```
62	
63	## Architecture Overview
64	
65	### Three-Tier Communication
66	
67	```
68	Frontend (Vue 3 :3000)  ──HTTP/SSE──>  Java Backend (:8080)
69	                                           │
70	                                     HTTP + X-Internal-Token
71	                                           │
72	                                    Python AI Service (:9000)
73	```
74	
75	- **Frontend** communicates only with Java backend (via Axios). Port 3000 proxies `/api` to `:8080`.
76	- **Java backend** owns auth (Sa-Token JWT), CRUD (MyBatis Plus + MySQL), file uploads, and SSE streaming. It proxies all AI requests to the Python service.
77	- **Python AI service** is the intelligence layer — only accessible internally via `X-Internal-Token` header. All business endpoints except `/health` require this token (HMAC constant-time comparison).
78	
79	### Java Backend (`java-backend/`)
80	
81	Standard **Controller → Service → Mapper → Entity** layered architecture under `com.hfusionhub`.
82	
83	- **Controllers** (7): HealthController, UserController, KnowledgeBaseController, DocumentController, ConversationController (SSE streaming), VectorizationController (callbacks), RagObservabilityController
84	- **Services** (5): UserServiceImpl, KnowledgeBaseServiceImpl, DocumentServiceImpl (file upload + vectorization trigger), ConversationServiceImpl (chat + SSE forwarding), VectorizationServiceImpl (index job management)
85	- **Entities** (7): User, KnowledgeBase, Document, DocumentChunk, DocumentIndexJob, Conversation, Message — all extend `BaseEntity` (createdAt, updatedAt, deleted logical delete)
86	- **Auth**: Sa-Token with JWT. 86400s timeout, 1800s active timeout. All paths except `/user/login`, `/user/register`, `/vectorize/**/callback`, and Swagger docs require login.
87	- **AI Client** (`client/AiClient.java`): HTTP calls to Python AI at `localhost:9000` with `X-Internal-Token`. Supports sync chat, SSE streaming, and cancellation.
88	- **Scheduler**: `DocumentIndexRecoveryScheduler` recovers stale index jobs (30 min stale threshold, 3 max attempts).
89	
90	### Python AI Service (`python-ai/`)
91	
92	Modular domain organization — the most architecturally complex subproject.
93	
94	**Agent System** (`app/core/agent/`):
95	- `ReactAgent` — ReAct loop: Thought/Action/Observation cycle (max 5 steps), intent classification, RAG retrieval, context compression, self-reflection, source citations
96	- `SingleAgentWorkflow` — bounded wrapper with timeout/retry (disabled by default, `RAG_AGENT_WORKFLOW_ENABLED`)
97	- `BoundedMultiAgentWorkflow` — runs agent then validates evidence with deterministic critic (disabled by default, `RAG_MULTI_AGENT_ENABLED`)
98	- Agent chaining: `get_agent()` factory wraps ReactAgent → SingleAgentWorkflow → BoundedMultiAgentWorkflow
99	
100	**RAG Engine** (`app/core/rag/`) — ~25 modules:
101	- `MultiChannelRetriever` orchestrates rewriting → routing → RRF fusion → reranking → postprocessing
102	- `QueryRouter` routes to Vector (Milvus), Keyword (BM25), and Graph channels with weighted RRF fusion
103	- `IntentClassifier` supports LLM/Rule/Hybrid strategies with caching
104	- `QueryDecomposer` splits complex queries into dependency-graph sub-questions
105	- `ContextCompressor` extractively compresses to ~60% target ratio
106	- `SelfReflector` evaluates answer quality via LLM/Rule/Hybrid strategies
107	- `ScopedGraph` — KB-scoped GraphRAG with deterministic entity co-occurrence
108	- `Reranker` — optional cross-encoder or lexical second-stage reranking
109	- Pattern: Strategy pattern used pervasively (intent classifier, router, reflector, multi-turn). Singletons for retriever, router, config, trace store.
110	
111	**LLM & Embedding** (`app/core/llm/`, `app/core/embedding/`):
112	- Abstract `BaseLLM` with `chat()`, `chat_stream()`, `ainvoke()`
113	- Implementations: DeepSeek (default), Ollama, Mock
114	- Embedding uses DeepSeek or Ollama (DeepSeek has no real embedding API — falls back to random vectors)
115	
116	**Vector Store** (`app/core/vectorstore/`):
117	- Milvus Lite with persistent file `milvus_data.db`
118	- 1024-dim FLOAT_VECTOR, COSINE metric, IVF_FLAT index
119	- Local `chunks_store.json` fallback
120	
121	**Key env feature flags** (all disabled by default, in `.env.example`):
122	- `RAG_GRAPH_ENABLED`, `RAG_RERANKER_ENABLED`, `RAG_MULTIMODAL_ENABLED`
123	- `RAG_AGENT_WORKFLOW_ENABLED` (P9), `RAG_MULTI_AGENT_ENABLED` (P10)
124	
125	### Frontend (`hfusionhub-frontend/`)
126	
127	Feature-based SPA with Vue 3 + Pinia + Vue Router.
128	
129	- **API layer** (`src/api/`): Axios instance injects `satoken` header, handles 401 redirect. Modules per domain (user, knowledgeBase, document, conversation, vectorization, rag).
130	- **Pages** (8): Login, Register, Dashboard, Knowledge (list/detail/chunks), Document, Chat (list/detail), RAG observability, Profile
131	- **Components**: Radix Vue-based UI primitives (button, card, dialog, input, select, badge), MarkdownRenderer (marked + dompurify), ToastContainer
132	- **Router**: Auth guard redirects to `/login`. MainLayout for authenticated routes.
133	
134	### Database
135	
136	MySQL with MyBatis Plus. Key tables:
137	- `sys_user`, `knowledge_base`, `document`, `document_chunk`, `document_index_job`
138	- `conversation`, `message` (with JSON `sources` field and `token_count`)
139	- Logical delete via `deleted` column on all major tables
140	- Default admin: `admin` / `admin123`
141	
142	SQL migrations at `java-backend/src/main/resources/sql/`.
143	
144	## Key Data Flows
145	
146	### Document Processing
147	1. User uploads → Java saves file, creates document (status=PROCESSING)
148	2. User triggers parse → Java sends HTTP to Python AI `/api/parse`
149	3. Python AI: parse → chunk (500 chars, 50 overlap) → embed → insert Milvus → update scoped graph → callback Java
150	4. Java callback → update `document_index_job` + `document_chunk` → mark document COMPLETED
151	5. Recovery: `DocumentIndexRecoveryScheduler` rescues stale jobs on restart
152	
153	### Chat
154	1. User sends message → Java saves to MySQL → calls Python AI `/api/chat` or `/api/chat/stream`
155	2. Python AI: intent classification → RAG retrieval → context compression → ReAct loop → self-reflection → source citations
156	3. SSE chunks flow: Python AI → Java `SseEmitter` → Frontend
157	4. Java saves assistant response (content, sources, model, token_count) to MySQL
158	
159	## Testing
160	
161	| Subproject | Runner | Test count | Location |
162	|---|---|---|---|
163	| python-ai | pytest + pytest-asyncio | 333 RAG test cases | `python-ai/tests/` |
164	| java-backend | JUnit (spring-boot-starter-test) | 2 test files | `java-backend/src/test/` |
165	| frontend | None configured | — | — |
166	
167	333 RAG test cases across 28 files covering: intent classification, query decomposition, context compression, self-reflection, query routing, multi-turn strategies, knowledge graph, chunk quality, multimodal, agent workflows, observability, API security.
168	
169	## Design Patterns
170	
171	- **Strategy pattern**: Intent classifier, self-reflector, query router, multi-turn strategy all use strategy pattern with factory creation
172	- **Singleton**: Global instances for retriever, config, trace store, knowledge graph manager, reflector
173	- **Fallback chains**: Embedding (Ollama → DeepSeek → random), Reranker (cross_encoder → lexical → disabled)
174	- **CQRS-like**: Java owns write path (documents, conversations), Python owns read/retrieval path
175	- **Idempotent indexing**: `document_index_job.index_version` prevents duplicate processing
176	- **Defense in depth**: KB ownership verified at Java (Sa-Token) and Python (callback secrets)
177

## 4. Potential Issues Found

1. **Missing `REDIS_PASSWORD` in `docker/.env`.** The docker-compose.yml uses `${REDIS_PASSWORD:?REDIS_PASSWORD must be set}`, which will cause the service to fail at startup because `docker/.env` does not define this variable. The `.env.example` does include it, so it was likely omitted by accident.

2. **Very bleeding-edge dependency versions.** The project uses `vite@^8.1.1`, `typescript@~6.0.2`, and `vue-tsc@^3.3.5`. These are extremely new (TypeScript 6.0 is not generally available; Vite 8 is also very recent). Compatibility between these versions has not been battle-tested. The `tsconfig.app.json` already has `"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"` and `"erasableSyntaxOnly": true`, which are TypeScript 6.x features, suggesting awareness of this. The project may have been scaffolded from a pre-release template.

4. **Root `.env` is empty.** The `.env` file at the project root exists but is completely empty. Depending on how the development tooling reads it, this could be misleading or cause startup issues for some services.

5. **The frontend README is generic.** It is the default Vue + Vite scaffolded README with no actual project-specific documentation.

6. **API authentication header uses the non-standard name `satoken`.** The request interceptor sets `config.headers['satoken']` rather than the standard `Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;`. This is consistent with the Sa-Token Java authentication framework used on the backend, but it means the proxy/auth is backend-specific.

7. **Potential `vue-tsc` and TypeScript version mismatch.** The build script runs `vue-tsc -b` (type-checking), but `vue-tsc@^3.3.5` paired with `typescript@~6.0.2` may have compatibility issues since `vue-tsc` typically lags behind the latest TypeScript releases. ## 6. Flyway 迁移 (`db/migration/`)

**目录：** `d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\java-backend\src\main\resources\db\migration`

共 **5 个迁移**：

### V1__initial_schema.sql
- 创建 `sys_user`、`knowledge_base`、`document`、`conversation`、`message`、`tool` 表
- 每个表都包含注释、外键、索引和 utf8mb4 字符集
- 插入默认管理员（`admin` / `admin123`，BCrypt 加密）
- 包含为用户 `hfusionhub` 赋予受限 DML+DDL 权限的 GRANT 语句（这是 MySQL 特有的，不会影响 Flyway）

### V2__document_index_persistence.sql
- 创建 `document_index_job` 和 `document_chunk` 表
- 用于持久的 RAG 索引作业跟踪

### V3__deletion_task_outbox.sql
- 创建 `deletion_task` 表，用于知识库/文档的异步 Outbox 模式删除

### V4__message_request_id.sql
- 向 `message` 表添加 `request_id` 列（`VARCHAR(64)`）以及唯一索引和覆盖索引，用于客户端幂等性

### V5__remove_default_admin.sql
- **删除**默认管理员账户，但仅在密码仍与已知默认 BCrypt 哈希匹配时
- 与 `AdminInitializer` 组件协同工作，后者使用环境变量 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` 创建/更新管理员

额外的 SQL 目录位于 `src/main/resources/sql/`，包含用于初始设置的 `init.sql` 和用于开发的 `reset.sql`。

## 7. 控制器、服务和实体 -- 概述

### 实体（8 个文件，位于 `com.hfusionhub.entity`）

| 实体 | 表 | 扩展 BaseEntity | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BaseEntity` | -- | -- | 抽象基类，含有 `createdAt`、`updatedAt`、`deleted`（逻辑删除），使用 MyBatis Plus fill |
| `User` | `sys_user` | 是 | `id`、`username`、`password`、`nickname`、`email`、`phone`、`avatar`、`role`、`status`、`lastLoginTime`、`lastLoginIp` |
| `KnowledgeBase` | `knowledge_base` | 是 | `id`、`name`、`description`、`userId`、`status`、`documentCount`（非持久化） |
| `Document` | `document` | 是 | `id`、`knowledgeBaseId`、`title`、`content`、`filePath`、`fileType`、`fileSize`、`chunkCount`、`status`、`errorMessage`、`processedAt` |
| `Conversation` | `conversation` | 是 | `id`、`knowledgeBaseId`、`userId`、`title` |
| `Message` | `message` | 否 | `id`、`conversationId`、`role`、`content`、`tokenCount`、`model`、`sources`（JSON type handler）、`createdAt`、`updatedAt`、`requestId` |
| `DocumentChunk` | `document_chunk` | 否 | `chunkId`（PK）、`documentId`、`knowledgeBaseId`、`indexVersion`、`chunkIndex`、`blockType`、`outlinePath`、`contentExcerpt`、`charCount`、`metadata` |
| `DocumentIndexJob` | `document_index_job` | 是 | `id`、`documentId`、`knowledgeBaseId`、`indexVersion`、`embeddingModel`、`status`、`attempt`、`chunkCount`、`errorMessage`、`startedAt`、`completedAt` |
| `DeletionTask` | `deletion_task` | 否 | `id`、`taskType`、`targetId`、`status`、`step`、`stepIndex`、`maxRetries`、`retryCount`、`errorMessage`、`createdAt`、`updatedAt` |

### 控制器（7 个文件，位于 `com.hfusionhub.controller`）

| 控制器 | 端点前缀 | 功能 |
|---|---|---|
| `HealthController` | `/health` | 简单的健康检查端点 |
| `UserController` | `/user` | 登录、注册、登出、获取/更新个人资料，按 ID 获取用户（管理员） |
| `KnowledgeBaseController` | `/knowledge-base` | 知识库 CRUD |
| `DocumentController` | `/document` | 文档上传、更新、删除、列表、解析 |
| `ConversationController` | `/conversation` | 对话 CRUD、发送消息、SSE 流式消息 |
| `VectorizationController` | `/vectorize` | 文档向量化、回调处理、状态同步 |
| `RagObservabilityController` | `/rag` | RAG 可观测性：追踪查询、导出、评估、评估运行 |

### 服务 （6 个接口 + 6 个实现，位于 `com.hfusionhub.service(.impl)`）

| 服务 | 实现 | 功能 |
|---|---|---|
| `UserService` | `UserServiceImpl` | 使用 BCrypt 登录、注册、登出、个人资料管理、速率限制 |
| `KnowledgeBaseService` | `KnowledgeBaseServiceImpl` | 知识库 CRUD，所有权检查 |
| `DocumentService` | `DocumentServiceImpl` | 上传（临时文件 -&gt; 原子移动）、更新、删除（级联清理）、列表、解析触发 |
| `ConversationService` | `ConversationServiceImpl` | 对话 CRUD、消息发送（阻塞 + SSE 流式）、幂等性 `requestId`、AI 客户端编排、批量 N+1 优化 |
| `VectorizationService` | `VectorizationServiceImpl` | 向量化管道回调、状态管理、重试、恢复 |
| `DeletionService` | `DeletionServiceImpl` | 异步 Outbox 式删除任务：KB 删除（带向量清理）和文档删除 |

### 其他关键组件

- **`AiClient`** (`client/`)：通过 RestTemplate 调用 Python AI 服务的 HTTP 客户端；支持阻塞和流式聊天
- **`JwtUtils`** (`common/utils/`)：围绕 Sa-Token `StpUtil` 的包装器，也实现了 `StpInterface` 以从 `User` 实体提供角色信息
- **`LoginRateLimiter`** (`common/limiter/`)：基于 Redis 的登录速率限制器（5 次尝试/15 分钟，15 分钟锁定）
- **`AdminInitializer`** (`config/`)：`ApplicationRunner`，如果提供了 `ADMIN_PASSWORD` 环境变量，则创建/更新管理员用户
- **`GlobalExceptionHandler`** (`common/exception/`)：全局 `@RestControllerAdvice`，处理 `BusinessException`、Sa-Token 异常、验证错误
- **`JsonTypeHandler`** (`handler/`)：MyBatis Plus 类型处理器，用于 Message 实体中的 JSON 序列化/反序列化 `List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; sources`
- **调度程序：** `DeletionTaskScheduler`（每 30 秒）、`OrphanCleanupScheduler`（每小时）、`DocumentIndexRecoveryScheduler`（可配置延迟）

## 8. 明显的问题

### 已发现的问题：

**1. `AiClient.chatStream()` 方法不是真正的流式传输。**
文件：`d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\java-backend\src\main\java\com\hfusionhub\client\AiClient.java`，第 109-165 行
`chatStream()` 方法设置 `stream=true` 但随后立即覆盖为 `stream=false` 并使用阻塞 `RestTemplate` 调用。它返回一个包含整个响应内容的 `StreamResponse`。真正的流式传输由 `ConversationServiceImpl.sendMessageStream()` 处理，该方法使用 `HttpURLConnection` 直接旁路 `AiClient`。这意味着 `AiClient.chatStream()` 基本上是一个死代码/误导性的 -- 所有实际的流式传输逻辑都在 `ConversationServiceImpl` 中。

**2. `application.yml` 和 `application.yml.example` 之间的差异。**
- `application.yml` 默认 `DB_USERNAME` 为 `hfusionhub`，而示例默认用 `root`
- `application.yml` 有 Flyway 配置部分和 MinIO 配置部分，而示例中没有
- `application.yml` 有 `app.admin.*` 配置，示例中没有
- 示例中没有 `rag.index.*` 属性
- 示例中没有 `ai-service.*` 配置

**3. 测试覆盖率低。**
只有 2 个控制器有测试（`HealthController` 和 `RagObservabilityController`）。6 个服务实现、5 个调度程序、映射器（mappers）、`AiClient`、`JwtUtils` 和 `LoginRateLimiter` 均无测试。

**4. 测试模式下的潜在 H2 兼容性风险。**
在 Flyway 中，V1 迁移使用 MySQL 特有的 GRANT 语句，而这些语句在测试中被跳过（Flyway 已禁用）。但测试的 `schema-h2.sql` 包含一个 `flyway_schema_history` 表，该表在测试中从未使用过（Flyway 被禁用）。这无害但显得杂乱。

**5. `FileStatus` 枚举在 V1 Flyway DDL 和实体之间不匹配。**
V1 迁移将文档状态注释为 "0-处理中，1-成功，2-失败"。但 `DocumentStatus` 枚举将其定义如下：`PENDING(0, "待解析")`、`PROCESSING(1, "解析中")`、`COMPLETED(2, "已完成")`、`FAILED(3, "失败")`。H2 schema 文档注释也与枚举匹配。实体/枚举使用与 V1 迁移中记录的状态不同的方案。

**6. 实体中缺少 `processedAt` 字段。**
`Document` 实体有一个 `processedAt`（`LocalDateTime`）字段，但该字段在 **任何一个** Flyway DDL（V1）中都没有对应的数据库列，也不在 H2 schema 中。这在实体和数据库 schema 之间是不匹配的。

**7. `LoginRateLimiter` 需要 Redis。**
如果在生产中没有 Redis 就运行应用，登录速率限制和 Sa-Token 会话存储将失败。测试配置正确地排除了 Redis，但在生产启动时需要 Redis 的健康运行。

**8. 空方法 `OrphanCleanupScheduler.retryLongFailedDeletionTasks()`。**
文件：`d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\java-backend\src\main\java\com\hfusionhub\scheduler\OrphanCleanupScheduler.java`，第 97-101 行。有一个带有 `@Scheduled(fixedDelay = 600_000)` 的调度方法，但其方法体为空，除了一条关于未来扩展的无用注释。

**9. `UserServiceImpl` 和 `RagObservabilityController` 中的密码泄露风险。**
`UserServiceImpl` 在日志中记录登录失败（包含用户名和 IP），这是好的。但如果启用了详细日志记录，`RagObservabilityController` 中的 `internalApiToken` 可能通过异常日志泄露。不过，这在使用 SLF4J 参数化日志记录的情况下是一个小问题。

## HFusionHub Python AI 服务 -- 全面探索报告

### 1. 项目概览

**根目录：** `d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\python-ai`

这是一个基于 FastAPI 的 RAG（检索增强生成）服务，为企业级文档问答而构建。它通过深化的流水线处理文档解析、分块（chunking）、向量化、多通道检索、代理执行和答案质量评估。该服务被预期由 Java 后端应用程序调用，而不是直接面向浏览器的 API。

---

**值得注意的差异：** `pyproject.toml` 要求 Python &gt;= 3.12，但 `requirements.txt` 在第 2 行声明了 `Python 3.11`。这可能是由于在运行 pip-compile 之前更改了 Python 版本要求而导致的潜在不匹配。

### 4. FastAPI 入口点

**文件：** `d:\college\development\0\HFusionHub\python-ai\app\main.py`

- 使用 `sys.path.insert(0, ...)` 将项目根目录添加到 Python 路径
- 配置标准库日志记录（也使用 loguru）
- 导入并注册三个 API 路由模块：
  - `app.api.vectorization` --&gt; `/api/parse`, `/api/search`, `/api/chunks`, `/api/task-status`, `/api/models`, `/api/documents/.../chunks`
  - `app.api.chat` --&gt; `/api/chat`, `/api/chat/stream`, `/api/chat/cancel`, `/api/chat/agent-runs`, `/api/chat/health`
  - `app.api.rag` --&gt; `/api/rag/traces`, `/api/rag/debug/search`, `/api/rag/graph/status`, `/api/rag/evaluate`, `/api/rag/evaluation-runs`
- 所有操作路由都使用 `require_internal_token` 依赖项进行保护
- 只有 `/` 和 `/health` 保持未认证状态
- CORS 中间件已配置（当 origin 为 `*` 时禁用 credentials）
- 自定义异常处理器：`HFusionHubException` -&gt; JSON，`HTTPException` -&gt; JSON，`Exception` -&gt; 通用 500
- 设计为由 `uvicorn app.main:app` 启动，或通过 `python app/main.py` 运行，后者使用 `config.SERVER_HOST` 和 `config.SERVER_PORT` 调用 `uvicorn.run()`

### 6. 核心模块

#### 6a. 代理模块：`app/core/agent/`

| 文件 | 用途 |
|------|---------|
| `agent.py` | `Agent` 抽象基类，`AgentResponse`/`AgentStep` 数据模型 |
| `react.py` | `ReactAgent` -- 624 行的 ReAct 循环实现，带意图分类、问题分解、RAG 上下文检索、工具执行和自我反思 |
| `collaboration.py` | `MultiAgentCoordinator` -- 专家角色（检索/分析/评判/综合）的并发执行 |
| `workflow_runtime.py` | `SingleAgentWorkflow` -- P9 有界代理包装器，具有超时、重试和运行追溯（无提示内容） |
| `multi_agent_runtime.py` | `BoundedMultiAgentWorkflow` -- P10 编排，带确定性证据审查 |

`__init__.py` 公开了 `get_agent()` 工厂函数，该函数根据功能标志有条件地包装 ReactAgent -&gt; SingleAgentWorkflow -&gt; BoundedMultiAgentWorkflow。

#### 6b. RAG 模块：`app/core/rag/`

一个广泛的多文件模块（约 25 个源文件）：

| 文件 | 用途 |
|------|---------|
| `base.py` | 策略基类（压缩/反思/分解/路由/评估/记忆/工作流节点） |
| `config.py` | `RAGConfig` 数据类层次结构，带有 `from_dict/from_file/from_env` 支持 |
| `models.py` | 核心数据模型：`IntentType`、`ComplexityLevel`、`DomainType`、`IntentResult` |
| `strategies.py` | 分类策略实现 |
| `intent_classifier.py` | 意图分类器工厂（LLM/规则/混合） |
| `query_decomposer.py` | 问题分解为子问题，带并行执行规划 |
| `query_rewriter.py` | 用于多轮对话的查询重写 |
| `query_router.py` | 多通道路由（向量/关键词/图谱） |
| `retriever.py` | `MultiChannelRetriever` -- 主要检索入口点，集成了重写+路由+重排序+后处理+可观测性 |
| `postprocessor.py` | 结果去重、排序、过滤 |
| `reranker.py` | 第二阶段重排序（词法/交叉编码器） |
| `context_compressor.py` | 上下文压缩策略（抽取式/生成式/混合式/递归式） |
| `self_reflector.py` | 答案自我反思（基于 LLM/规则/混合的质量评分） |
| `answer_quality_evaluator.py` | 使用多个维度的答案质量评估 |
| `conversation_memory.py` | 对话记忆管理（滑动窗口/基于令牌/摘要/基于重要性/混合） |
| `knowledge_graph.py` | 知识图谱存储（Neo4j/内存），实体/关系提取 |
| `scoped_graph.py` | 作用域 GraphRAG -- 仅来自所选 KB 中的块 |
| `multimodal_rag.py` | 多模态 RAG 流水线（图像嵌入、跨模态检索） |
| `multi_turn_strategy.py` | 多轮对话策略 |
| `adaptive_retrieval.py` | 自适应检索规划 |
| `observability.py` | 检索追溯存储和统计 |
| `evaluation.py` | 检索评估框架（Recall、MRR、nDCG） |
| `evaluation_runs.py` | 持久化评估运行存储（SQLite） |
| `agent_workflow.py` | 通用工作流引擎（DAG 节点执行） |
| `utils.py` | 工具函数（令牌估算、关键词、句子分割、相似度） |
| `cache.py` | 缓存机制 |

`__init__.py` 重导出所有公共 API 并管理全局单例（`get_intent_classifier()`、`get_retriever()`、`get_compressor()`、`get_reflector()`、`get_evaluator()` 等），带有专门的 `reset_*` 函数用于测试。

### 7. 注意到的问题

1. **Python 版本不匹配：** `pyproject.toml` 声明 `requires-python = "&gt;=3.12"`，但 `requirements.txt`（第 2 行）声明它是通过 pip-compile 使用 `Python 3.11` 生成的。这可能在 3.12 上运行时导致兼容性问题。

2. **提交了 API 密钥：** 活动 `.env` 文件包含一个硬编码的 DeepSeek API 密钥（`sk-b5c2e639feb24c34b43aafd3b309c7ac`）。这已在 Git 中提交，是安全风险。

3. **空的 `__init__.py`：** `app/core/vectorstore/__init__.py` 为空，而 `app/core/tools/__init__.py`、`app/core/agent/__init__.py` 等则有实质内容。这不是功能性问题，但风格上不一致。

4. **`chat.py` 中的未定义变量：** 在 `chat.py` 的第 915 行，`run_stream()` 方法引用了 `final_answer`（`eval_sample` 中的 `response=final_answer if 'final_answer' in locals() else ""`），但在之前的流式路径中，`final_answer` 可能从未被定义。即使有 `locals()` 回退检查，这也是脆弱的。

5. **嵌入回退行为：** `DeepSeekEmbedding` 类（`embedding/deepseek.py`）正式声明 DeepSeek 不提供嵌入 API，始终引发 `EmbeddingException`。因此，实际的嵌入回退链是：Ollama -&gt; 错误 -&gt; 随机向量（仅限测试）。Ollama 在任何像样的生产设置中都是必需的。

6. **Milvus Lite + JSON 元数据存储：** `milvus_store.py` 维护了一个本地 `chunks_store.json` 文件，作为 Milvus Lite 不可靠的 `query()` API 的替代方案。这引入了两个存储之间的状态不一致的可能性。

7. **缺少 `test_retriever.py`：** 尽管有深入的路由器、重排序器、压缩器和评估器测试，但没有专门针对 `MultiChannelRetriever` 类本身的测试文件。检索器在 `test_rag_observability.py` 和 `test_rag_access_contract.py` 中间接测试。

8. **没有 `setup.py`：** 该包通过 pyproject.toml 使用基于 setuptools 的构建，但项目根目录中没有 `setup.py`。找到的 `setup.py` 文件位于虚拟环境的 site-packages 内。

---

vue-tsc -b && vite build\nnpm run audit                     # 检查高危安全漏洞\n```\n**预期结果：** TypeScript 类型检查通过，构建成功，无高危 CVE。\n\n### 第 4 阶段：Docker Compose — 配置验证\n```\ncd docker\ndocker compose config             # 验证合并后的 YAML\n```\n**预期结果：** 添加 `REDIS_PASSWORD` 后成功输出配置。\n\n---\n\n## 要应用的修复\n\n### 修复 A：将 `REDIS_PASSWORD` 添加到 `docker/.env`\n将 `REDIS_PASSWORD=<生成的密码>` 追加到 `docker/.env`。\n\n### 修复 B：为 `Document.processedAt` 创建 Flyway V6 迁移\n- 新文件：`java-backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__add_document_processed_at.sql`\n- 内容：`ALTER TABLE document ADD COLUMN processed_at DATETIME NULL COMMENT '处理完成时间' AFTER error_message;`\n- 更新 `schema-h2.sql`：在 `document` 表 DDL 中添加 `processed_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL`\n\n### 修复 C：清理已提交的 API 密钥\n- 从 `python-ai/.env` 中移除 DeepSeek API 密钥\n- 验证 `.gitignore` 包含 `.env` 模式\n- 使用 `git rm --cached python-ai/.env` 停止跟踪敏感文件（如果已跟踪）\n- 轮换 DeepSeek 上的密钥——当前的 `sk-b5c2e6...` 已泄露\n\n---\n\n## 非阻塞性警告（文档记录，推迟修复）\n\n| # Java 健康检查\ncurl http://localhost:9000/health           # Python 健康检查\ncurl http://localhost:3000                  # 前端 HTML\n# 浏览器：http://localhost:3000 → 登录页面\n# 首次运行：使用 ADMIN_PASSWORD 凭据登录（admin / <你的密码>）\n```\n\n---\n\n## 验证检查清单\n\n- [x] Java `mvn test` → 4/4 通过\n- [x] Python `pytest` → 615+ 通过\n- [x] 前端 `npm run build` → 成功 + 零高危审计\n- [x] `docker compose config` → 有效 YAML\n- [ ] `docker compose up -d` → MySQL 健康 + Redis 健康\n- [ ] Python 服务在 9000 端口响应 `/health`\n- [ ] Java 服务在 8080 端口响应 `/api/health`\n- [ ] 前端代理 `/api` → Java 后端\n- [ ] 登录流程（admin + ADMIN_PASSWORD）\n"}

## 关键发现

2. **`Document.processedAt` 字段没有数据库列** — 实体有该字段，V1 migration 和 H2 schema 都没有它，`VectorizationServiceImpl` 在运行时设置它 → SQL 错误
3. **DeepSeek API 密钥提交到仓库** — `python-ai/.env` 中的真实密钥（`sk-b5c2e6...`）是安全风险

**🟡 8 个非阻塞性警告：** `AiClient.chatStream()` 死代码、空的调度方法、配置差异、embedding 回退需要 Ollama、`chat.py` 脆弱的变量、Python 版本元数据不匹配、前端无测试、空的根目录 `.env`

## Approved Plan:
# HFusionHub 完整项目测试与启动计划

## Context

该三层次单体仓库（Java Spring Boot + Python FastAPI + Vue 3）需要对所有三个子项目进行全面测试。代码库探索发现了 **2 个阻塞性问题**（需要在启动前修复）、**3 个应在此次修复的严重问题**以及若干可以推迟的非阻塞性警告。

## 发现的阻塞性问题（必须在启动前修复）

### 1. docker/.env 中缺少 `REDIS_PASSWORD` — 阻断 docker compose
- **文件：** `docker/.env`
- **问题：** `docker-compose.yml` 使用 `${REDIS_PASSWORD:?REDIS_PASSWORD must be set}`，但 `.env` 没有定义它
- **影响：** `docker compose up` 将以错误退出
- **修复：** 将 `REDIS_PASSWORD=your_redis_password` 添加到 `docker/.env`

### 2. Document.processedAt 字段没有数据库列 — 运行时会崩溃
- **文件：** `Document.java:88` — 实体有 `private LocalDateTime processedAt` 字段
- **文件：** `VectorizationServiceImpl.java:220,315` — 设置 `document.setProcessedAt(LocalDateTime.now())`
- **问题：** V1__initial_schema.sql（第 57–76 行）和 schema-h2.sql（第 57–72 行）都没有 `processed_at` 列
- **影响：** 任何文档向量化回调都将因 SQL 错误失败
- **修复：** 创建一个新的 Flyway 迁移 V6，将 `processed_at` 添加到 `document` 表，并更新 `schema-h2.sql`

### 3. DeepSeek API 密钥已提交到仓库 — 安全风险
- **文件：** `python-ai/.env` 第 7 行
- **问题：** 真实 API 密钥 (`sk-b5c2e639...`) 已提交到 git
- **影响：** 如果仓库是公开的或共享的，密钥已泄露
- **修复：** 轮换密钥，将 `.env` 添加到 `.gitignore`（如果尚未添加），通过环境变量注入密钥

---

## 测试计划（分阶段执行）

### 第 1 阶段：Java 后端 — 单元测试 + 编译
```
cd java-backend
mvn test                          # H2 数据库，4 个测试（HealthController + RagObservabilityController）
mvn package -DskipTests           # 验证完整编译
```
**预期结果：** 4/4 通过。如果 `processed_at` 修复正确，编译应成功。

### 第 2 阶段：Python AI 服务 — 615+ 个测试
```
cd python-ai
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/Scripts/activate    # Windows
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest -q tests                   # 615 个测试，27 个文件
```
**预期结果：** 所有测试通过。此项不涉及任何修复。

### 第 3 阶段：前端 — 类型检查 + 构建 + 审计
```
cd hfusionhub-frontend
npm ci
npm run build                     # vue-tsc -b && vite build
npm run audit                     # 检查高危安全漏洞
```
**预期结果：** TypeScript 类型检查通过，构建成功，无高危 CVE。

### 第 4 阶段：Docker Compose — 配置验证
```
cd docker
docker compose config             # 验证合并后的 YAML
```
**预期结果：** 添加 `REDIS_PASSWORD` 后成功输出配置。

---

## 要应用的修复

### 修复 A：将 `REDIS_PASSWORD` 添加到 `docker/.env`
将 `REDIS_PASSWORD=<生成的密码>` 追加到 `docker/.env`。

### 修复 B：为 `Document.processedAt` 创建 Flyway V6 迁移
- 新文件：`java-backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__add_document_processed_at.sql`
- 内容：`ALTER TABLE document ADD COLUMN processed_at DATETIME NULL COMMENT '处理完成时间' AFTER error_message;`
- 更新 `schema-h2.sql`：在 `document` 表 DDL 中添加 `processed_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL`

### 修复 C：清理已提交的 API 密钥
- 从 `python-ai/.env` 中移除 DeepSeek API 密钥
- 验证 `.gitignore` 包含 `.env` 模式
- 使用 `git rm --cached python-ai/.env` 停止跟踪敏感文件（如果已跟踪）
- 轮换 DeepSeek 上的密钥——当前的 `sk-b5c2e6...` 已泄露

---

## 非阻塞性警告（文档记录，推迟修复）

| # | 问题 | 严重程度 |
|---|-------|----------|
| W1 | `AiClient.chatStream()` 死代码——始终设置 `stream=false` | 低——真实流式传输在 ConversationServiceImpl 中 |
| W2 | `OrphanCleanupScheduler.retryLongFailedDeletionTasks()` 空方法体 | 低——占位符 |
| W3 | `application.yml` 与 `.example` 默认值差异 | 低——混淆风险 |
| W4 | 嵌入式回退需要 Ollama——DeepSeek 没有嵌入式端点 | 中——生产需要 Ollama 运行 |
| W5 | `chat.py` `final_answer` 可能未定义（脆弱的 `locals()` 检查） | 低——由 guard 子句处理 |
| W6 | Python 版本元数据不匹配（pyproject.toml 要求 3.12，requirements.txt 显示 3.11） | 低——在任一环境中都能正常工作 |
| W7 | 前端无测试基础设施 | 中——新增，应优先处理 |
| W8 | 根目录 `.env` 为空 | 低——无影响 |

## 成功启动步骤（修复 + 测试通过后）

### 前提条件
- **JDK 17**（`java -version`）
- **Python 3.12**（`python --version`）
- **Node.js >=20.19**（`node --version`）
- **Docker Desktop** 正在运行

### 1. 启动基础设施（MySQL + Redis）
```bash
cd docker
docker compose up -d
# 等待健康检查通过（~30 秒）
docker ps  # 确认 mysql8 和 redis7 都在运行
```

### 2. 启动 Python AI 服务（端口 9000）
```bash
cd python-ai
source .venv/Scripts/activate   # Windows
$env:PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
$env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="<your-key>"
python -m app.main
# 输出：Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:9000
```

### 3. 启动 Java 后端（端口 8080）
```bash
cd java-backend
# 设置必需的环境变量（从 docker/.env 匹配值）
$env:DB_USERNAME="root"
$env:DB_PASSWORD="46124b69e5304874b5a6773b736d6f63"
$env:REDIS_PASSWORD="<你设置的 redis 密码>"
$env:CALLBACK_SECRET="40cca2901f7140e4a45257ecd1b70cd0"
$env:PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
# 可选：首次运行管理员
$env:ADMIN_PASSWORD="YourSecurePassword"
mvn spring-boot:run
# 输出：Started HFusionHubApplication ... on port 8080
```

### 4. 启动前端开发服务器（端口 3000）
```bash
cd hfusionhub-frontend
npm run dev
# 输出：Local: http://localhost:3000/
```

### 5. 验证部署
```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/api/health      # Java 健康检查
curl http://localhost:9000/health           # Python 健康检查
curl http://localhost:3000                  # 前端 HTML
# 浏览器：http://localhost:3000 → 登录页面
# 首次运行：使用 ADMIN_PASSWORD 凭据登录（admin / <你的密码>）
```

# HFusionHub 项目启动计划

## 上下文

所有修复和测试已完成（上一轮）。本项目现已准备好启动。该计划覆盖完整的 4 个服务启动顺序：Docker（MySQL + Redis）→ Python AI → Java 后端 → 前端。

## 前提条件检查

启动前，先验证所需的运行时是否可用：
- `docker ps` — Docker Desktop 正在运行
- `java -version` — JDK 17
- `python --version` — Python 3.12（本项目使用 3.11.9 全局安装版——已验证可正常工作）
- `node --version` — Node.js ≥20.19

## 启动顺序

### 步骤 1：Docker 基础设施（MySQL 8.0 + Redis 7）— 后台运行

```bash
cd docker
docker compose up -d
# 等待约 30 秒，让健康检查通过
docker ps  # 确认两个容器都在运行且健康
```

### 步骤 2：Python AI 服务（端口 9000）— 后台运行

```bash
cd python-ai
$env:PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
$env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="sk-b5c2e639feb24c34b43aafd3b309c7ac"
python -m app.main
# 绑定到 0.0.0.0:9000
```

### 步骤 3：Java 后端（端口 8080）— 后台运行

```bash
cd java-backend
$env:DB_USERNAME="root"
$env:DB_PASSWORD="46124b69e5304874b5a6773b736d6f63"
$env:REDIS_PASSWORD="2f8a7b3c9d1e4567abcdef8901234567"
$env:CALLBACK_SECRET="40cca2901f7140e4a45257ecd1b70cd0"
$env:PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
$env:ADMIN_PASSWORD="admin123"
mvn spring-boot:run
# 绑定到 0.0.0.0:8080，上下文路径 /api
```

### 步骤 4：前端开发服务器（端口 3000）— 后台运行

```bash
cd hfusionhub-frontend
npm run dev
# 绑定到 localhost:3000，/api 代理到 localhost:8080
```

### 步骤 5：验证

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/api/health    # Java 健康检查
curl http://localhost:9000/health         # Python 健康检查
curl http://localhost:3000                # 前端 HTML（应返回 index.html）
```

浏览器：`http://localhost:3000` → 使用 `admin` / `admin123` 登录

## 验证清单

- [ ] Docker：`mysql8` 和 `redis7` 处于 healthy 状态
- [ ] Python：`http://localhost:9000/health` 返回 `{"status": "ok"}`
- [ ] Java：`http://localhost:8080/api/health` 返回 `{"status": "UP"}`
- [ ] 前端：`http://localhost:3000` 加载登录页面
- [ ] 登录：使用 `admin` / `admin123` 完成

## 启动流程参考

启动过程中发现并修复了以下 **3 个额外问题**：

### 第 1 步：Docker（MySQL + Redis）
```bash
cd docker
# 注意：Redis 开发环境无密码（通过 127.0.0.1 绑定保护）
docker compose up -d
```

### 第 2 步：Python AI
```bash
cd python-ai
export PYTHONPATH="$(pwd)"
export PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="sk-b5c2e639feb24c34b43aafd3b309c7ac"
python app/main.py    # <-- 必须是 "app/main.py"，而非 "-m app.main"
```

### 第 3 步：Java 后端
```bash
cd java-backend
export DB_USERNAME="root"
export DB_PASSWORD="46124b69e5304874b5a6773b736d6f63"
export CALLBACK_SECRET="40cca2901f7140e4a45257ecd1b70cd0"
export PYTHON_AI_INTERNAL_TOKEN="d12f9dfb93954ee39d5eebb301b38925"
export ADMIN_PASSWORD="admin123"
mvn spring-boot:run
```

### 第 4 步：前端
```bash
cd hfusionhub-frontend
npm run dev
```

### 第 5 步：验证
```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/health
curl http://localhost:8080/api/health
curl http://localhost:3000
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/user/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"admin123"}'
```

### 启动过程中进行的修复

| # | 问题 | 修复内容 |
|---|-------|--------|
| F1 | V4 Flyway 迁移在 MySQL 8.0 中使用了无效的 `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` | 移除 `IF NOT EXISTS` 子句（MySQL 不支持） |
| F2 | `chat/Detail.vue:206` 中 `requestId` 作用域错误 | 将 `requestId` 声明移到 `try` 块外部 |
| F3 | Redis `bind 127.0.0.1` + `protected-mode` + `requirepass` 组合导致 Lettuce 在 WSL2 上连接失败 | 移除 Redis 密码，设置 `protected-mode no` + `bind 0.0.0.0`，开发环境安全性由 docker-compose 的 `127.0.0.1` 端口绑定保证 |
| F4 | `python -m app.main` 在 Windows Git Bash 上失败 | 改用 `python app/main.py`（配合 `PYTHONPATH`） |
